weaknesses.title: FN catalog is process-local — no plate rehydrate of FNs
weaknesses.detail: LISTFNS/HASFN/FNINFO only see FNs defined in the current process. Multi-run ARG agents re-declare FNs each fire; cannot load FN catalog from STATE plate. Clear cannot un-define FNs.
weaknesses.repro: clear leaves LISTFNS still 4; second process without FN bodies empty catalog

weaknesses.title: TRYCALL arity mismatch behavior unclear vs soft miss
weaknesses.detail: Unknown FN is soft. Wrong-arity CALL may still hard-fail depending on body; agents must FNINFO gate before TRYCALL with correct arg count. No automatic arity check on TRYCALL.
weaknesses.repro: TRYCALL score with 0 args — agent must pre-gate NPARAMS

weaknesses.title: No FNWHERE / tagged catalog — flat name bag only
weaknesses.detail: LISTFNS returns all FNs. Cannot filter by prefix/tag (runbook vs util). Agents substring-filter bags manually; false friends risk.

weaknesses.title: HASFN resolves string vars (contrast HASMETHOD)
weaknesses.detail: Positive: HASFN STEP works with string var. Documents inconsistency with HASMETHOD which does not resolve vars — agent mental model split across OOP vs FN surfaces.
weaknesses.repro: HASFN STEP with STEP=score → 1; HASMETHOD Handler MNAME fails

weaknesses.title: SETMATCH first exact line only
weaknesses.detail: Journal setmatch replaces first matching line; duplicates need loop.

weaknesses.title: REQUIRE=abc softens
weaknesses.detail: Non-numeric REQUIRE leaves NEED_HIT=0; miss exits 0.

weaknesses.title: Bare CALL unknown is fatal — TRYCALL required for optional hooks
weaknesses.detail: Agents must remember soft form; HASFN gate + CALL still races if FN deleted mid-script (not possible now but twin of SEND).
weaknesses.repro: CALL ghost would hard-fail; TRYCALL ghost soft
